Tenants.no_vacant_rooms: * No vacant rooms currently available! Set room status to Vacant first.
Tenants.cannot_delete_active_contract: Cannot delete! This tenant currently holds an active rental contract.
Tenants.share_link_prompt: Or share this link — tapping it in Telegram connects automatically:
Tenants.telegram_connect_instructions: The tenant taps the link (or opens the bot and sends the code) — their account connects automatically, no chat ID needed.
Tenants.telegram_connect_hint: After registering, generate a connect code from the tenant list to link their Telegram account.

Tenants.id_images_required: Please upload a photo of the back of the ID card.
Tenants.id_wait_upload: Please wait for the ID photo to finish uploading.
Tenants.apply_deposit: Use the deposit to pay this tenant's unpaid invoices first
Tenants.apply_deposit_help: Any deposit left after that is refunded to the tenant.
Tenants.con_deposit_received_help: Tick if you already have the deposit (it won't be added to the move-in invoice).
Tenants.con_move_in_invoice_help: Deposit + first month's rent (prorated from the start date). Utilities come with the first monthly invoice.
Tenants.con_rates_help: Leave empty to use the building / system rate (changes in Settings apply automatically). Enter a value only for a special rate.
Tenants.delete_lease_hint: Delete lease (only if it has no invoices)
Tenants.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
Tenants.move_out_explain: This records the final meter reading, issues a final invoice (utilities + rent for this month if not billed yet, prorated to the day), settles the deposit and frees the room.
Tenants.moved_out_summary: Deposit applied to invoices: {applied} · refund to tenant: {refund}
Tenants.suspend_hint: Pause billing while the tenant keeps the room
